item.finding: The verified principal that the requirements make mandatory never reaches the operation through any documented Interface. The Authentication Boundary requires access review to trust only the verified principal passed in by the existing caller boundary, the Dependencies text and the authority table name that boundary as the authority for verified identity, and the security authority Input requires the boundary to hand the verified principal and the requested operation to the review boundary. The only documented input is reviewAccess(request) with non-empty resourceId and operation; no Interface defines how the verified principal is delivered, and no result contract covers an absent or unverified principal. The Testing Decisions still require a public lifecycle test that the verified principal comes from the existing caller boundary, so this authentication boundary requirement has no implementable input channel and no failure contract.
